TestCase.name: testBatchInterleavedInputFieldsAndPythonFunctions
TestCase.Resource: SELECT a, asyncFunc1(a, b), c, pyFunc1(b, c), a FROM MyTable
LogicalProject(a=[$0], EXPR$1=[asyncFunc1($0, $1)], c=[$2], EXPR$3=[pyFunc1($1, $2)], a0=[$0]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])

Calc(select=[a, f0 AS EXPR$1, c, f1 AS EXPR$3, a AS a0]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, c, f0, pyFunc1(b, c) AS f1]) +- PythonAsyncCalc(select=[a, c, b, asyncFunc1(a, b) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testBatchInterleavedInputFieldsAndPythonFunctionsWithCondition
TestCase.Resource: SELECT a, pyFunc1(b, c), c, asyncFunc1(a, b), a FROM MyTable WHERE b > 0

LogicalProject(a=[$0], EXPR$1=[pyFunc1($1, $2)], c=[$2], EXPR$3=[asyncFunc1($0, $1)], a0=[$0]) +- LogicalFilter(condition=[>($1, 0)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])

Calc(select=[a, f0 AS EXPR$1, c, f1 AS EXPR$3, a AS a0]) +- Calc(select=[a, c, f00 AS f0, f0 AS f1]) +- PythonCalc(select=[a, c, f0, pyFunc1(b, c) AS f00]) +- PythonAsyncCalc(select=[a, c, b, asyncFunc1(a, b) AS f0]) +- Calc(select=[a, b, c], where=[(b > 0)]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])

TestCase.name: testBatchNestedAsyncPythonFunctionWithAnotherAsyncPythonFunction
TestCase.Resource: SELECT asyncFunc2(asyncFunc1(a, b), c), asyncFunc1(a + 1, b) FROM MyTable
LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[asyncFunc2(asyncFunc1($0, $1), $2)], EXPR$1=[asyncFunc1(+($0, 1), $1)]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])

Calc(select=[f0 AS EXPR$0, f1 AS EXPR$1]) +- PythonAsyncCalc(select=[f1, asyncFunc2(f0, c) AS f0]) +- PythonAsyncCalc(select=[c, f00 AS f0, asyncFunc1(f0, b) AS f1]) +- PythonAsyncCalc(select=[c, f0, b, asyncFunc1(a, b) AS f00]) +- Calc(select=[a, b, c, (a + 1) AS f0]) +- TableSourceScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]], fields=[a, b, c])

LogicalProject(EXPR$0=[pyFunc1(asyncFunc1($0, $1), $2)], EXPR$1=[pyFunc1(asyncFunc1($0, $1), $2)], EXPR$2=[42]) +- LogicalTableScan(table=[[default_catalog, default_database, MyTable]])
